title: NormalizedAlert
description: Normalized alert produced by Bhavya's ingestion pipeline. This is the ONLY valid input format for the ML Brain module.

alert_id.description: UUID v4 — unique identifier for this alert event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the alert.

source_ip.description: IPv4 address of the suspected attacker.

destination_ip.description: IPv4 address of the target service.

service.description: Which microservice was targeted. Must match Docker service names.

attack_type.description: Classification of the detected attack vector.

severity.description: Severity level derived by the ingestion pipeline.

raw_event_count.description: Number of raw SIEM events that were aggregated into this alert.

features.description: Normalized numeric/boolean features extracted from raw events for ML consumption.

request_rate_per_min.description: Requests per minute from source IP to this service.

unique_paths_accessed.description: Number of distinct URL paths accessed in this session.

failed_auth_count.description: Number of failed authentication attempts in the window.

payload_contains_sql_keywords.description: Whether any request payload matched SQL injection keyword patterns.

user_agent_anomaly.description: Whether the User-Agent header was absent, malformed, or known-malicious.

geo_anomaly.description: Whether source IP geo-location deviates from baseline.

wazuh_rule_id.description: Optional: Original Wazuh rule ID that triggered this alert.

wazuh_rule_description.example: sshd: brute force trying to get access to the system.
